checks.title: Device version reported (inventory)
checks.rationale: Identify the IOS/IOS XE train for vulnerability triage.
checks.remediation: Compare 'show version' against Cisco PSIRT advisories for the running train.

checks.title: SSH version 2 only
checks.rationale: SSHv1 is broken; only v2 is acceptable.
checks.remediation: conf t ; ip ssh version 2 ; end.

checks.title: HTTP server is disabled
checks.rationale: The cleartext HTTP management server should be off; use HTTPS or SSH.
checks.remediation: conf t ; no ip http server ; end.

checks.title: Service password-encryption is enabled
checks.rationale: Type-7 passwords are weak but better than cleartext in running-config.

checks.title: Enable secret (not enable password) is configured
checks.rationale: Type 8 (PBKDF2) or type 9 (scrypt) are the secure options; legacy type-7 is reversible.
checks.remediation: conf t ; enable algorithm-type scrypt secret <password> ; end.

checks.title: VTY lines restricted to SSH transport
checks.rationale: telnet must be off on management lines.
checks.remediation: conf t ; line vty 0 15 ; transport input ssh ; end.

checks.title: VTY access-class applied to limit management source IPs
checks.rationale: Source-IP allowlist on VTY lines contains exposure during credential leaks.
checks.remediation: conf t ; ip access-list standard MGMT ; permit <subnet> ; line vty 0 15 ; access-class MGMT in ; end.

checks.title: Logging buffered at notification level (5) or higher
checks.rationale: On-device buffered logs aid first-pass incident triage.
checks.remediation: conf t ; logging buffered 32000 notifications ; end.

checks.title: NTP authentication / trusted-key configured
checks.rationale: Authenticated NTP prevents spoofed time updates affecting cert/Kerberos validity.
checks.remediation: conf t ; ntp authenticate ; ntp authentication-key 1 sha256 <key> ; ntp trusted-key 1 ; ntp server <ip> key 1 ; end.

checks.title: Manual: SNMP communities are not default and use v3 with authPriv
checks.audit: Run 'show running-config | include snmp-server'. Confirm no 'public' / 'private' communities and that v3 users are configured with auth + priv (sha + aes).
checks.rationale: Default SNMP communities allow information disclosure and config changes.
checks.remediation: Remove community strings; configure 'snmp-server group ... v3 priv' with sha+aes.
